bias.en: Bearish · broke $1,115, lowest close since July
bias.zh: 看空 · 跌破 $1,115，收盘创 7 月以来新低

read.en: SanDisk fell 6.6% on Nov 2 to $1,075.08, its lowest close since Jul 29, trading between $1,067.40 and $1,159.31. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,253.1), 10-day ($1,276.4), 30-day ($1,512.5) and 100-day ($1,600.8) averages and the rising 200-day ($1,262.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,402.58), and RSI is 30, at the oversold line.
read.zh: 闪迪 11月2日下跌 6.6%，收于 $1,075.08，为 7月29日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $1,067.40–1,159.31。股价位于下行的 5 日（$1,253.1）、10 日（$1,276.4）、30 日（$1,512.5）和 100 日均线（$1,600.8）以及上行的 200 日均线（$1,262.5）下方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$1,402.58），RSI 为 30，处于超卖边缘。

read.en: The drop broke the $1,115–1,121 support (Oct 30 and Aug 3 lows), now resistance, after an early high of $1,159.3. Resistance is $1,115–1,121, then $1,150.9–1,159.3 (Oct 30 close, Nov 2 high) and $1,229–1,239 (Oct 23 and 26 lows, Oct 30 high). Support is $1,048–1,051 (Jul 28 and May 1 lows), then $998.2 (Jul 29 low). A close above $1,121 would target $1,150–1,159; below $1,048, $998.

r.en: Oct 23 and Oct 26 lows ($1,228.9–1,229); Oct 30 high $1,239
